Trailer for In The Grey in 4K ULTRA HD Quality

In the Grey Plot : When billions get stolen, they are the pros who steal it back. Watch Jake Gyllenhaal, Henry Cavill, and Eiza González in the official trailer for #InTheGrey. Written & Directed by Guy Ritchie. Only in theaters May 15.

In The Grey follows a covert team of elite operatives who live in the global shadows, as comfortable wielding power and influence as they are automatic weapons and high explosives.  When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, the team is sent to steal it back on what would be for anyone else a suicide mission. What begins as an impossible heist gets much worse, spiraling into an all-out war of strategy, deception and survival.

In the Grey is an upcoming American action thriller film written, co-produced and directed by Guy Ritchie. Produced by Black Bear Pictures, the film stars Henry Cavill, Jake Gyllenhaal, Eiza González, Kristofer Hivju, Emmet J. Scanlan, Jason Wong, Michael Vu, Fisher St
